intent: Show the income-tax baseline across income groups before other taxes are added.

requirements.question: What is the baseline shape of income taxes across the eleven groups?

units.claim: Income-tax rates rise from the poorest group through the tenth group, peak at about 18%, and then fall to about 10% for the top group.
accept: the tenth bar is the maximum at about 18%
the final bar falls to about 10%
reject: showing the final group as the maximum
reversing the order of the income groups
units.evidence: Use the corresponding visible bars/segments in the selected keyframe.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all role=bar bars or stack segments; annotation rows excluded
